PARAMS = {
    "I":     (65e-6, 55e-6, 66.5e-6),   # total NMOS current
    "fp":    (0.33, 0.15, 0.5),         # fraction of I supplied by the PMOS current source
    "RD":    (13.3e3, 10e3, 18e3),
    "gmidp": (14, 8, 20),
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),
    "Ln":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    VDD = 1.8
    vin = 0.75
    I, RD, Ln = p["I"], p["RD"], p["Ln"]
    Ip = p["fp"] * I
    IR = I - Ip
    vout = VDD - IR * RD

    # NMOS: W such that Id(Vgs=vin, Vds=vout) = I
    Wn = 10.0
    for _ in range(4):
        on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
        Wn = max(0.42, Wn * I / on["Id"])
    on = lut.op("n", Wn, Ln, vin, vout)
    rn = lut.size("n", max(on["gm_id"], 3), Ln, I, vds=vout)

    # PMOS current source supplying Ip
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ip, vds=max(VDD - vout, 0.1))
    vsg = mp.vgs
    Rtot = 3e6
    R1 = Rtot * vsg / VDD          # vdd -> pg
    R2 = Rtot - R1                 # pg -> vss

    mb = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, iref, vds=0.7)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.M("MN", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", "nfet", round(Wn, 3), Ln)
    n.R("RD", "vdd", "vout", RD)
    n.dev("MP", "vout", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("RB1", "vdd", "pg", R1)
    n.R("RB2", "pg", "vss", R2)
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)

    cout = rn.cdd + rn.cgd + mp.cdd + mp.cgd
    G = 1.0 / RD + on["gds"] + mp.gds
    A = on["gm"] / G
    f3 = G / (2 * PI * (cl + cout))
    power = VDD * (I + iref + VDD / Rtot)
    swing = VDD - mp.vdsat - on["vdsat"] - 0.1

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(A),
        "f3db": f3,
        "gbw": A * f3,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": vout,
        "swing": swing,
    }
